pitch.heading: Up the hill into Hessel
pitch.text: The south road comes down to the river Lim, and on the far side Hessel goes up its hill in tiers of steam and honey-coloured stone: the spa where the old come to be mended and the young to be married, in the last four days of its Season. You have a little money, no letters of introduction, and nothing to do there but see it.
